title: Change the company's default time zone
when: The step asks to change the org-wide Default Time Zone on the Company Information page, the default given to new users. It is not changing one user's own time zone, and not business hours.
steps: In the embedded Company Information page, click 'Edit'.
Choose the requested zone in the 'Default Time Zone' dropdown. It is a long list: name the option exactly as listed.
doneWhen: Company Information shows the requested Default Time Zone after saving.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 3 actions, 16 s, reviewer confirmed, and it held in a fresh session. Confirmed without any model: the Setup Audit Trail recorded changedOrganizationTimezone, and SOQL on Organization returned TimeZoneSidKey = Australia/Brisbane. The first attempt failed: Default Locale's hundreds of options filled the control table, so the Time Zone dropdown was never offered. Long dropdowns are now one target.

trial.step: Change the company default time zone to Australia/Brisbane.
